title: Sable and the Cipher
author: Kestrel Blackwood
blurb: Ines Dunmore, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
